user_query: I'm organizing a surprise party for my best friend and I need some suggestions for popular songs to create a lively atmosphere. Can you provide me with a list of tracks from the current music charts? Additionally, I'd like to find the lyrics for one of the songs on the list. Thanks!

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of current popular songs from the music charts
Select one song from the list of popular songs for which to fetch lyrics
Get the lyrics for the selected song
